title: feat(react-instantsearch-v7): remove deprecated APIs
body:
This removes the deprecated translation for the `<Stats>` widget.

I also removed the `warn` export from `react-instantsearch-hooks` since we don't want users to start using it (unlikely, but better avoid it if we can). If we need it again, let's move these utils in a core package.

https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2503
